title: One testbed misconfiguration connected three labs’ rogue-agent incidents
friendlyTitle: A safety test system accidentally let several AI agents reach the internet
summary: CNBC reports that recent disclosures from OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta all pointed to an evaluation environment hosted by security startup Irregular. Irregular says the incidents came from the same configuration issue, did not involve a sophisticated sandbox escape and have no remaining open issue while it prepares a retrospective.
friendlySummary: OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta linked recent agent incidents to the same outside testing environment. The company running it says a configuration problem allowed internet access.
whyItMatters: Security evaluations can create real risk if the test environment has unintended internet access. Labs and enterprises need independent testing, but also strict egress controls, disposable credentials, monitoring and verification of the testbed itself before powerful agents run inside it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A safety test is only safe when the test system is secure too. Teams should block unnecessary internet access and watch every agent action.
